pageProps.title: Geureom Oedo
pageProps.review: A review of the small and cozy Cafe Geureom Oedo near Woldaecheon in Jeju City, featuring the traditional dessert Jeungpyeon and the cafe's relaxing atmosphere.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Jeungpyeon", "rating": 3 } --- A familiar and decent taste! ``` ## Review Unfortunately, Tamrajuak was sold out, so I ordered Jeungpyeon, which was still worth eating. It's small and cozy. ## Pictures
